t: goal
Use the Imperial Flare near 3 Dead Soldiers. Report to Yasskul Herneith in the Old Barracks afterwards.
startText

I am Yasskul Herneith, the leader of the IMD Priests. I am quite skilled in holy magic if I do say so myself. The power of Tensess is the foundation of holy magic. One of the most curious things is the fact that this power works even on those who do not believe in "Tensess' Gift".
This is very convenient, for losses on the battlefield are inevitable. As long as the body of a fallen soldier is fairly intact, we will be able to use this power to resurrect them and send them back into battle.
Right now I am conducting an educational course on how to perform resurrections in battle conditions. You are going to help my students out by finding the bodies of fallen soldiers.
You should find several if you look around the vicinity of these training grounds, and when you do simply light this flare. My students will follow the signal and perform the resurrection rite immediately. At least they better - the Imperial Army is no place for failures!
checkText
Being killed in a scrap with termites is not exactly an honorable way to go. We must revive our fallen warriors.
finishText
I must express my gratitude to you. You have helped return a number of fine soldiers to the army, and hopefully those students will be able to repeat the process on a real battlefield!
goal
Report to Yasskul Menkheperre at Cape Stronghold.
startText

The termites have been exterminated and their queen has been cast down. She truly was a repellent creature! Now it's time for you to head to Cape Stronghold and report to Admiral Yasskul Menkheperre. The names some of these Arisen have are real jaw-breakers, aren't they?
On the coast you will go through the final stage of your training and resume the War Games. I have no doubt that you'll make it through just fine, but you still need to prove yourself to the rest of the army!
finishText

As you can see, there is a very good model of a Kanian fortress over there. It's called Mondovi Fortress, and the rules of the War Games dictate that the Blue battalion will defend the fortress while the Reds try to conquer it. Right now we need to make a few preparations before we begin our assault.
goal
Kill 2 Trained Hyenas and 2 Blue Hyena Handlers. Then report to Yasskul Menkheperre at the Cape Stronghold.
startText

Before we storm the fortress we need to make sure our rear is safe.
The Blues are currently patrolling these shores quite heavily. Among their ranks are many tame hyenas and their handlers. They pose perhaps the biggest threat to our forces.
I hope you've been to the Imperial Training Camp and know how to deal with several enemies at once. Lessons of Sino the Merciless would help you here! If you want to avoid trouble, try attacking the handlers when there are no hyenas nearby.
Your task is simple: eliminate two trained hyenas and two Blue handlers.
Go!
checkText
I can't imagine anything more unpleasant that having those hyena fangs sink into my back.
finishText
Now the Blues inside the fortress will only be able to count on their own resources. The hyenas and their handlers are no longer a distraction!
goal
Plant the Model Bomb inside Mondovi Fortress and report to Yasskul Menkheperre.
startText

Now it is time to assault Mondovi Fortress. If you manage to complete the next task I have for you, your training will be completed and it will be a full and definite victory for the Reds.
Listen up carefully. I am about to give you a model of a powerful magic mine. Once you board that Astral ship over there it will take you to the allod where the fortress is located. As soon as you disembark, the Blues will attack you on sight. You are allowed to use any methods possible to repel them.
Your task is to break through to the center of the fortress and set up the model there. As soon as you do this, the neutral observer inside will announce a victory for the Reds! And then that's it, you'll be a hero!
I'll tell you a little secret - many years ago I was also a new recruit of the Red battalion. That year we also crushed the Blues, and I would really love to see our flag flying above the parade grounds once again. Don't let us down!
checkText
Wow, you're here already? Did you set the bomb yet?
finishText

Great job! That means you are entitled to another new promotion. Too bad there's no time to celebrate - the battle alarm was just sounded.
A few Astral ships from the League tried to land nearby, but most of them were defeated out in the Astral. Unfortunately one ship got through to Lookout Isle and now it's crawling with their soldiers.
goal
Go to Lookout Isle and report to Colonel Sefu.
startText

Several League ships attempted to land on the coast just to the northeast of here. According to our agents' reports, the official aim of the invasion was to rescue their prisoners of war. However, it appears that this rescue operation was nothing more than a diversion.
Their real goal was to take Lookout Isle. It's very close to Nezebgrad and if the League manages to hold it, they will control a strategic point from which to attack our capital!
The Red and Blue battalions are the closest troops to Lookout Isle. It's not a good idea to send rookies into battle against hardened League soldiers, but I'm afraid we have no choice right now.
Use your Adventurer's Stone to activate the ancient June ruins just outside the walls. They should send you directly to Lookout Isle. Some of our troops are already there but they desperately need backup. Do all that you can to stop the League from achieving their evil goals!
checkText
At ease, soldier! I have no time for ceremonies.
finishText
Good, we need more troops. There are a ton of League soldiers crawling all over the allod and without reinforcements we're done for.
goal
Bring 2 Astral Shards and 2 Diluted Mana Potions to Colonel Sefu at the Cape Stronghold.
startText

The "Hand of Tensess" is the name of the ship that landed on Lookout Isle. Our agents reported that it is commanded by Admiral Adrian Govorov. Our intelligence service would love to have a chat with him, but he doesn't appear to be the sort of man that would let himself be taken alive.
Actually, I just got an idea. I think I have a plan that will help us get around that little problem. Our agents should be able to extract information from the admiral's brain if we can deliver it to them intact.
However, it will need to be magically preserved as soon as the admiral dies or this won't work. Gather some Astral shards from the shore line and bring me some mana potions as well. I'm sure you can find some potions on the League soldiers out there. From those I should be able to make a pretty good embalming solution.
Hurry, the information he provides could be crucial to the battle!
checkText
All of the Arisen know their magic, even soldiers like me, but I can't do anything without Astral energy and mana.
finishText
Good, now that I have the shards and the mana potions I can create that embalming solution.
goal
Kill Admiral Adrian Govorov and put his head in the Large Box. Then deliver it to an Imperial agent at the ZIT Headquarters.
startText

I have poured the embalming solution into this sealed container. You will find the Admiral on his ship, all the way at the western end of this allod. When you kill him, make sure that you don't mess up his head! It needs to be completely intact, so aim your blows elsewhere!
I am afraid that this will be an exceedingly difficult task, but I don't know anyone else that would be able to do it. Maybe you know some powerful comrades that would be able to help you out.
After you get the head, put it in the box and deliver it to an Imperial agent at the ZIT Headquarters. I have sent word that you will be coming, and the army should have someone waiting to meet you. After that, they'll know what to do. Ah, magic is so useful, isn't it?
checkText
We were expecting you. I hope the admiral's head was not damaged en route.
finishText
Excellent, the head is in perfect condition. Now all we have to do is extract the information from the brain. This head may prove more valuable than a whole squad of Imperial soldiers!
goal
Defeat 4 League Troopers. Report to Crazystorm the Merciless in Nezebgrad.
startText

Ah, I see you're here, too...
Look, I'd rather not talk about the past. But if you did a great job rearranging my face before, I'm sure you could really mess up those League soldiers!
There are too many of those mongrels. Our boys can't handle their numbers.
Kill four enemy soldiers. Report to Crazystorm in Yasker's Tower when you're done.
checkText
I know about everything you did on Lookout Isle. Your fame precedes you.
finishText

Adrian Govorov obviously overestimated his strength when he led his forces to Lookout Isle. I hear that you completely decimated them! Let this be a lesson to League - they will never be able to defeat the Empire!
goal
Inform Wrokag the Northwind about the death of Voxar the Fierce.
startText

This Orc fought bravely, for his body is surrounded by many League soldiers. He must been a particularly dangerous opponent because the enemy took the time to cut off his head. Now there is no way to resurrect him.
On the dog tag next to his body there is a name - Voxar the Fierce. This is the descendant of the Legendary Orc that Wrokag the Northwind sent you to find. Poor devil, he never made it back to Nezebgrad - he was thrown into the cauldron of war, where he sunk without a trace.
You should report the death of Voxar to Wrokag as soon as possible. This is sad news indeed, but he will still want to know it.
checkText
You don't look too happy. Plus, I had a bad omen yesterday. I know it's bad news, so just tell me already.
finishText

So, Voxar is dead. This is terrible news, but we will not lose heart. The Legendary Orc must have other descendants. We found one, so we can find another! Now let us pause a moment to honor the memory of Voxar.
goal
Find the missing soldier on the Lookout Isle and return to Frunt the Roughneck.
startText

Here is the deal... One of my soldiers has gone missing. I sent a squad on a scouting mission, and they ran into a Kanian outsentry. And instead of retreating, they chose to come at them with bare hands.

Four of them are back from the Purgatory, and now they are going to clean the toilets with their toothbrushes till the end of their service, but the fifth soldier is still nowhere to be seen. This is unacceptable, you know. I am responsible for them, after all.
checkText
If I find out that the soldier chickened out and deserted the battlefield, I will make him rot in the guardhouse till the end of his days! The Empire doesn't need cowards!
finishText

So this is it... He fought till his last breath and died the worst death... He will surely be granted a medal. Or even an order. Postmortem...

Eternal glory to the fallen heroes!
goal
Bring 4 League Soldier's Badges to Shildar the Wily on the Lookout Isle.
startText

Hey, hello there! Wow, only yesterday you were just a rookie. You didn't even have a proper belt to hold your pants up! And now look at you - you're a high-ranking officer!
Er, I meant no disrespect, sir! I was recently deployed here to Lookout Isle with the other Reds to defeat the League scum. For now they seem to be beating us, but today we were given new battle tactics. They're sure to turn the tide.
What are they? Why, a new military competition has been declared! The one who knocks off the most League Cadets will be declared a hero!
Our troops are supposed to collect the soldiers' badges and bring them to me. Then a report on their deeds will be forwarded to headquarters that recommends they be given the highest honors! Oh, one more thing - there's no point in bringing me less than ten badges. I can't send the report unless you do.
checkText
Have you managed to rough those League soldiers up?
finishText
Aha, ten badges already! This system is working perfectly! We should continue this tradition. That report will be sent right away!
goal
Bring 4 Glossy Snake Skins to Shildar the Wily in the Red Barracks.
startText

A-ten-hut! You are now one of us. And that means that you follow our rules! Let's see, your haircut is okay and you look clean enough. Now let's look at the most important part - your uniform.
This won't do at all! Your hat's askew, and I can't even see my reflection in your boots. What a mess! And what is that belt you're wearing?! Where did you get that thing?
The belt is one of the most important parts of a soldiers uniform! You are ordered to find a suitable replacement for that thing you're wearing immediately.
The best belts are made from the skins of the snakes that live right outside our barracks. Go bring me a bunch and I'll help you fix your uniform. Now go to it and no back talk!
checkText
What are you, afraid of snakes? You would do better to be afraid of me - I can be quite merciless when I'm angry!
finishText

Give them here, let me count them. One, two... uh, looks like they're all here! I know how to count. They don't promote dimwits around here you know. Here's your new belt. Put it on. Now you're a true soldier!
goal
Kill 4 Foul Slugs and report back to Tomar the Filthy in the Red Barracks.
startText

As your punishment you will help out over at the cesspool. It's to the west of here.
We already have crews of goblins collecting the products of our vital functions. They recently sent in a report about the slugs. These creatures keep multiplying, and now they're a huge nuisance to the goblins. They haven't been able to do their work. And you don't want to know what will happen if this continues! Or do you?
Something needs to be done fast. Go down there and squish them into oblivion!
So kill 4 slugs and report to the main goblin Sort this out before it gets worse.
checkText

Yes, I know what I smell like. This is an occupational hazard! The important thing right now is to get rid of those slugs. We kept squishing the them all day yesterday, but they seem to be never ending...
finishText
Thanks for your help! I'm sick of these slugs, almost all work has been halted because of them. Now it's back to cleaning the cesspool! Yay!
goal
Kill Slimecrawler near the sewage pipe and treat the carcass with Solidifier X2SM.
startText

Recently a huge slug showed up in the cesspool. I've named him Slimecrawler and the last time I went to work I barely got away from him, honest! He needs to be killed as soon as possible!
Unfortunately, simply hacking him up won't do the trick. You see, slugs multiply by budding. New slugs will spawn from the corpse if we don't do something about it, so you need to take this solidifier and apply it to Slimecrawler's carcass. It will turn it to stone right away.
And one more thing - make sure you kill Slimecrawler in a good spot. If you finish him near a drain pipe and sprinkle him with solidifier, his corpse could plug a pipe! Where will all of the soldiers' feces go then? That's right - back to the barracks! Do you want that to happen?!
checkText
Where did I get the solidifier? It was sent to this base for testing, but it didn't turn out to be very useful to the army so I swiped it for myself!
finishText
Did you really manage to finish that thing? Wow! Maybe you'd like a permanent job as my assistant? You'd get really good benefits you know!
goal
Report the sabotage on the Blue Barracks to Maya Shinelina.
startText

Slimecrawler's corpse seems to have plugged up the Blues' drain pipe. Soon it will overflow and all of the sewage will rush back to their barracks. You should report your success to Lieutenant Shinelina.
finishText

Hah, that's great! Well I suppose we did everything we could. I mean, that slug did have to be eliminated. And if someone doesn't like something, they can deal with the issue themselves. Am I right, soldier?
goal
Find the three missing goblins and return their badges to Denis Stepashin as proof of your deeds.
startText

There's a review on the battalions' drill routines coming up soon. The past three times we've lost to the Blues, but this time things will be different! I have commandeered a goblin orchestra to play during our routine. That will put some fire in the troops!
The only problem is, half of the musicians have disappeared - three goblins are missing. We'll be humiliated on the parade grounds without music. Colonel Stepashin over there has practically lost his voice running around and shouting for the goblins all day long.
Help him out and search the area around the parade grounds. Make sure those goblins return safe and sound to Stepashin on the double! You do understand how important this task is, right? Good! Backwards march and go find those goblins!
checkText
Where are those damned musicians? I've always said that goblins can't be relied on!
finishText

Phew... all the goblins have returned! Now it's up to our boys to put on the performance of their lives!
Now, what song should we play? "Brave Soldiers, Think of your Wives"? No, if we sing about their wives they'll start daydreaming and fall out of step. How about "Nezeb Gave Us Steel Wings"?
goal
Eliminate 4 Bumble Bees and collect 4 dead Bumble Bees. Report to Denis Stepashin.
startText

Oh, this event is so stressful. It's been a long time since the Reds won it.
Even now I fear we have no chance. Things just keep going wrong! First the goblins disappear, and now these bees are everywhere as if someone smeared honey all over the place. Wait... Come to think of it, that could be a possibility. Those Blues are vicious.
Why don't you help me out here. The bees might start stinging our brave soldiers any minute, and then all of our hard work will go down the drain. One will fall out of step, another will yelp at the wrong moment - it'll be a catastrophe!
Kill four bees and make sure to remove their bodies. Use this sack to collect the dead bees. I don't want to take any chances - those evil things must go!
checkText
Are the bees still around? I think I can hear buzzing.
finishText
Great, these things won't get in our way now. Let these insects flit about somewhere else!
goal
Deliver Horch the Garrulous back to Denis Stepashin.
startText

Ouch, ouch, ouch! My poor little ankle! I've sprained it and I can't move. If you want me to get back to the parade grounds you'll have to carry me. There's no way I can walk!
Make sure that you're careful! I won the Goblin Prize for Best Music, you know. I'm a very important person! I can't imagine how furious my superiors would be if you accidentally injured one of my hands on the trip back!
checkText
What kind of a drill routine will it be without music?! We'll be a laughing stock!
finishText

This invalid will play - there's nothing wrong with his hands.
But I suppose we'll have to issue officer quality rations to him for his trouble.
goal
Bring 4 Honeycombs to Buga the Gluttonous.
startText

I've loved sweets my entire life, but when I was young my father never had any money to buy them. Now that I'm older I take every opportunity I can to eat something sweet. And lucky for me I found these hives full of honey!
In a word, I'm not budging from this place until I've had my fill. If you want me to follow you, bring me some honeycombs until I've had enough. Once I'm stuffed with sweets, I'll put on the best performance you've ever heard!
checkText
Don't even try to talk me out of this. Without honey I'm not budging. Ah, the buzzing of these bees is such beautiful music!
finishText
That's it, I can't eat any more - I think I'm going to burst. Thanks for the treat, I'll run on over to the parade grounds now. Don't worry, I know the way.
goal
Find the Red Flag and bring it to Denis Stepashin.
startText

Damn it! Things just keep falling apart! What, you don't know what happened? Our flag was stolen! The one with the lion's head on it! If we don't get that flag back in time the Red battalion will be automatically disqualified.
Why don't you check around some of the Blue soldiers' camps. They've got to have it. That would be just like them! This is against the law but they're not ones to stand on ceremony you know. Get that flag back and give them what they deserve.
checkText
Move it, time is running out. The review is coming soon and we'll look like idiots without our flag!
finishText

Where was it? The Blues had it?! That's what I thought. I'm going to report this to Commissar Preminina. I know she won't let something like this slide. Those Blues have lost any sense of decency.
By the way, I have a reward here for you from battalion's storeroom. Good job soldier, we all owe you our gratitude!
goal
Kill Sinax and notify Denis Stepashin of your deeds.
startText

Help me, please!
While I was taking a stroll around the parade grounds I ran into a gigantic hyena! I'm deathly afraid of the creatures - have you seen the size of their teeth? I know that the drill routine is starting soon, but there's no way I can get back unless that hyena dies or I learn to scale fences! ...You were sent to fetch the goblin musicians?
That's perfect then! Go kill the hyena for me - he's skulking around in that thicket, but I know he's watching me, waiting for me to move! Oh, he's so terrifying!
Once he's taken care of I'll be able to rush back to the parade grounds on my own.
C'mon, why are you standing there? Take him out before he strikes!
checkText
Would I ever have anything to do with those goblins again?! Not on your life, I swear on my uniform!
finishText

Ah, it was you that helped Lupas get back to the camp? Good job! We should invite you to give speeches to the new recruits, detailing all of the heroic things you've done lately. It would be good for their morale.
goal
Watch the performance of the Red battalion and inform Denis Stepashin about the victory.
startText

I'm trembling with anticipation! Now there are no more reasons to panic - the goblins are in their places, the flag has been returned, and the Reds have been training for months. We're going to win, I just know it!
Those Blues shouldn't have relied on dirty tricks and treachery. We have foiled all of their plots and now my boys will show them such a parade! Their performance will be so good, even Yasker himself would be proud to see them. Oh look, it's going to start any moment!
Wait, stay a while and share the triumph with me. Huzzah! Go Reds!
checkText
"...It is hard to overestimate Yasker's role in creating..." Sorry, I was practicing a speech. What news have you got?
finishText

We won? That's great! A healthy spirit of competition helps our soldiers in their combat training. I have good news for you as well - you're being promoted to corporal. Congratulations!
And what should your response be? Right! "I live to serve the Great Empire!"
goal
Report to Sino the Merciless at the Imperial Training Camp.
startText

Now that you're a corporal we will begin to expect more from you. That means you will now head to the Imperial Training Camp located to the northwest of our barracks. This is a mandatory stage in the training of each defender of the Motherland. Imperial soldiers must be able to deal with any obstacle!
Once you get there, report immediately to Sino the Merciless. He is an experienced trainer and every army recruit has had to pass through his clutches. Each and every one of them had many kind words for the fellow when his training saved their life.
Go on, I need to finish this speech before the end of the day, and you need to begin your training! Dismissed!
finishText

The new recruits are all weaklings these days. I'm afraid to even imagine what's going to happen to them on the battlefield!
I hope you're not like that. I suppose I'll find out shortly!
goal
Take readings from the 3 Ancient Totems and report to Sino the Merciless.
startText

Alright, let's get to work. Surrounding this training camp are three totems that emit magical vibrations. If any of the Orcs that pass through here possess magical abilities, the totems will recognize this and store the memory of them. They just need to be checked periodically so their readings can be taken.
It's good that you're here so you can help me gather the latest batch of information. Just go up to each and inspect them carefully. Unless the spirits are feeling particularly mischievous, they should tell you the information you need to know.
checkText
So, how did things go? Did you get the readings?
finishText

This is fantastic! One of the totems recorded magical powers. Do you understand what that means? One of the Orcs that passed through here could be a Great Mage! I need to go through my records and find out who it is. Here, take some of these supplies. They should come in handy!
goal
Scale all three walls, touch the Marked Boulder, and report to Sino the Merciless.
startText

Time to start your training! Now I hope you're not afraid of spiders, for we breed the little beasts here just for the benefits of the recruits.
You're going to need to make your way over the three walls up on that hill there. They'll all have ropes hanging from them that you can use to scale them, if you can get past the spiders that is.
My advice is to kill all of them, and quickly - others will soon come to take their place. In order to complete the mission, you need to touch the marked boulder at the top of the platform. Now off you go!
checkText
The spiders were specially selected just for the training course! They're fat, angry, and evil. All just for you!
finishText
So, you managed to deal with the spiders and the fences. That's a tick on your progress chart.
goal
Eliminate 4 Phantom Soldiers. Then report to Sino the Merciless at the Imperial Training Camp.
startText

The next one is my favorite test. You see, the enemy is wily and treacherous.
 Those cowards from the League... They tend to fade into the woodwork as soon as they know that the jig is up. Now, what is an Imperial soldier to do in such a situation? That's right - make sure the enemy doesn't escape and finish off the scum! And that's exactly what you'll learn to do now.
A ghost is able to escape the field of battle very quickly. Blink and it's gone. That means you will only have one minute to finish them off.
Go now and don't come back until you've eliminated four of them.
checkText
Do not fear ghosts. Remember that you are a soldier of the Empire and you must be able to act swiftly and ruthlessly.
finishText
Well done! You're finished with the ghosts, let me make a note of that.
goal
Kill 2 Mantis Guards and 2 Carnivorous Plants. Then report to Sino the Merciless at the Imperial Training Camp.
startText

The third test is the toughest. Enemies frequently move in groups and help each other out in combat. But that's not a problem for Imperial soldiers, right?
Have you ever seen a carnivorous plant? It's a special type of vegetation that can crawl, attack and, interestingly enough, heal! The thing is, there's usually a mantis crawling around together with the plant. The plant restores the mantis' health, and the mantis protects the weak plant.
Go out and destroy two pairs of them. Obviously, the plant should be killed first and then you can easily finish off the mantis.
checkText
As I've already explained, first gut the plant and then kill that damned mite! It's really quite simple!
finishText
I never doubted that you could do it. Let all the flora and fauna tremble before the soldiers of the Empire!
goal
Report to Sino the Merciless about your success at the Imperial Training Camp.
startText

Great job! If all soldiers were like you, victory would be as good as ours! You will surely have many occasions to remember me with a kind word in the future. Maybe one day you can treat this old soldier to a mug of something hot.
finishText

Train hard, fight easy! Well said, right? Apparently you finished your training with flying colors. This is excellent. These are the kind of results I was expecting from you. As a reward for your success, I am granting you a new weapon.
goal
Ask the Blue Ensign about Voxar the Fierce.
startText

I found it! Look, it's a new recruit from the Blue battalion. His name appears to be Voxar the Fierce. Go to the Blue Barracks and find him as soon as possible. I don't know why, but I have a bad feeling about this...
Oh, I forgot! You're a Red aren't you? That's going to make this a little more difficult, but you have to do something. Find a way to gain their trust. I would start with the local ensign - he's a real softie once you get to know him!
finishText

What do you want here? If you're looking for a thrashing, I can certainly oblige.
Hmm, so you're looking for Voxar? He's not here and I certainly won't tell you where he is. You're a Red and therefore the enemy, even if this is only a game.
Although... if you help me, I might be able to help you.
goal
Report to Blue Lieutenant Khagar at the Blue Barracks.
startText

Good, I'm glad that you're here. I have a task for you, and it's a very important one.
The War Games will start again soon and we will battle the Blues once again. Parts of the rules dictate that we exchange messengers. They will send several of their soldiers to us and vice versa. The messengers' official job is to relay the official challenge, but their real purpose is to steal secret documents from the enemy.
I hear that you're not new to spying and I don't think I'll find a better candidate. The Blues will be aware of your objective and technically aren't allowed to attack you, but this rule is rarely observed.
Anyway, go to the Blue barracks and report to their lieutenant. He is required to give you a secret clue on the documents' locations, but you'll only be able to figure it out if you've got a good head on your shoulders!
finishText

Alright, let's see who they sent us. Hah! You might as well go relax on that bench - you'll have about the same chance of finding those documents as if you actually looked.
According to the rules of the game, I am obliged to give you several tips. Whether or not you will be able to understand them - that's your problem.
goal
Use the first clue and attempt to kill hyena to find the second clue and report your findings to Semer Senedj.
startText

Well, here's your first clue. As you know, the hyena is our mascot. I personally don't believe in this shamanic mumbo-jumbo, but the soldiers believe they are special creatures and they treat them with great reverence. Just try to touch our hyenas and you'll see for yourself!
Stop making bug eyes at me. That's it! I don't have to tell you anything else, so you're on your own now!
checkText
Ah, hello colleague! I'm glad to see you! This is so frustrating, I feel like banging my head against these rocks! Unfortunately that wouldn't help much.
finishText

You were told about some strange totem too, eh? I'm certain that this is the thing they were talking about, but I have no idea how it's connected to our task.
I've tried pouring hyena blood over the thing, but it's no use. The documents have to be hidden here, but how do we get to them?! Those damn Blues... What, hold on, I've got an idea!
goal
Defeat 3 Blue Privates and return to Fith the Forester.
startText

Hey you - Red! Having a nice stroll, are you? You seem to be walking around without a care in the world! Lost all fear of the Blues, eh?
Man, if it hadn't been for this nonsense about the messengers being protected by a truce, we would have gutted you like a pig. Do you realize that? Or do you think you're untouchable? At the moment you are because of that damned uniform. If you took it off then we'd see who was so tough!
Or actually, how about we do it this way. The rule says you're only untouchable while you're in the base! We have a little arena set up right outside the gates where the Blues usually spar, but I think today we can make you the guest of honor. Don't be afraid - we fight fair. It'll only be one on one. Go ring the gong if you think you have the guts to face us.
checkText
What, scared? That's what I thought. We've always beaten you Reds, and we always will!
finishText
Okay, that's enough! We've learned our lesson, none of the other Blues want to challenge you. Why don't we have a drink together instead. A truce - let's be friends!
goal
Bring 4 pieces of Juicy Venison to Abram Ordin.
startText

Here's the thing.
There's a shortage of food in the warehouse. Let's just say some rats got in there or something. A ton of canned stew is missing. And I have an inspection coming up.
Basically, I need to make up for the shortage pronto. Of course you won't be able to get your hands on good canned stew - it's always in short supply. But if it's replaced with fresh venison... things may still work out all right. I might even get a commendation! They'll see that Abram Ordin is a good ensign and makes sure the soldiers' diet is full of fresh meat!
Bring me 4 pieces of venison and I'll tell you everything you need to know about Voxar the Fierce.  We have plenty of deer here in the prairies, so you shouldn't have to look very far.
checkText
A deal's a deal. You bring me the meat and I'll give you the information. Otherwise you're not getting anything out of me!
finishText

Wonderful! That makes this the seventeenth audit that I'm going to live though.
What was it I promised you? Oh, right, you wanted information about Voxar!
goal
Find Voxar the Fierce in the eastern part of Igsh Military District.
startText

So, about Voxar. He was recently sent to Termitka Prison. Nah, he didn't do anything. I just got a memo that they were running low on prison guards, so I had to send someone. I was already sick and tired of Voxar and his practical jokes so he was a natural candidate.
If you want to find him you should head over there. It's over to the east near the termite mounds - you can't miss it. Maybe seeing what prison life is like will make Voxar straighten up and fly straight! Hah!
finishText

Who are you and what do you want?
Listen, I haven't the slightest idea what you're talking about. Yeah, I do have certain abilities, but so what?
I'm a true Orc, not some whacked out shaman. If I were a shaman, do you really think I would have ended up in this cage?
goal
Get to the Imperial Hospital. Bring 4 Vials of Centipede Poison to Evgeny Mogilin.
startText

Doctor Mogilin just ordered that you be sent to the hospital.
Nah, nobody's going to treat you for anything - we have enough patients. What they need is an assistant!
If Mogilin is personally asking for you that must mean he likes your reputation. Man, working at the hospital is a gravy train! It's an easy job with great perks. You should be jumping with joy!
Oh, and one more thing before I forget. The doctor asked that you bring him some centipede poison when you report in. Don't forget to collect some on the way - you don't want to make a bad first impression!
checkText

No, I won't give you medical leave. This isn't some sort of resort you know.
Oh, you're the new assistant! I'm sorry. The things these soldiers will do just to get out of work!
finishText

The poison of the local centipedes can be turned into a valuable medicine. This is a great start, but we have lots more work to do! I'm glad that my request for an assistant has finally been approved.
goal
Obtain 4 Bromine Crystals and bring them to Evgeny Mogilin at the Imperial Hospital.
startText

During wartime certain basic instincts are useless and even harmful. Do you know what I'm talking about? Okay, let me explain. To put it simply, the soldiers think about women too much. Or possibly other men, whatever.
Fortunately we have discovered a remedy for this. Go north to the dry riverbed and gather ten bromine crystals. When it's added to the soldiers' food it almost completely eliminates their desires. I know this for a fact - I was the first test subject! It's quite an amazing substance!
checkText
Yes, I know the area is crawling with centipedes, but I'm sure this little fact won't stop you!
finishText

Good job. The Imperial soldiers must think only of victory and nothing else! Pleasure can be had after the enemy puts down their weapons, and not before! Now where did my nurse go? She's supposed to start putting these in the soldiers' food...
goal
Use the Lasso to hobble 4 Xadaganian Mares and use the Empty Pitcher to milk them. Bring 4 Pitchers of Milk to Evdokia at the Imperial Hospital.
startText

Hello! Are you going to just stand there? Or are you going to help me out? Great!
We are in urgent need of milk right now. The best kind is straight from the wild mares that live around here - it's very good for the wounded. Go into the fields and milk four of them. But first you have to catch and hobble them. Here's a lasso - just throw it on a mare and it'll hold her in place. Don't worry, it's a lot easier than it sounds. Then you can milk her. Oh, and one more thing.
 I hope you're able to tell a mare from a stallion. Make sure it's a mare or you'll bring me something else...
checkText
Are you having difficulties milking some horses? I thought soldiers could handle anything!
finishText
Thanks, this is just in time for our patients' next meal! What can be better for a soldier than a cup of fresh mare's milk with a little bromine mixed in? Heehee!
goal
Install 2 Micro-Cameras in the Imperial Hospital for Osip Produnov.
startText

Hey, you there, help me out! No, not by emptying the bedpan. This is a more serious matter. You have time to assist a fellow Red, right?
You see, I miss female company so much that I can't stand it anymore! And that bromine of theirs doesn't help. Yes of course I know about, it's not that hard to overhear nurses when they gossip. Too bad their quarters are all the way across the square - they spend so much of their time where I can't see them.
But that might change soon! With your help, of course. You see, I managed to get this little camera from one of the Arisen guards. Go over to the nurses' rooms and install it wherever you can. I'll never forget this, comrade, I promise! I'm just dying with frustration in this bunk!
checkText
Oh, if it wasn't for this wounded arm I'd be out there scooping up the ladies in no time!
finishText

I know that peeping isn't nice, but I can't help it! When I look at a woman nothing else is important anymore - this war, the Reds, the Blues...
Every woman looks beautiful to me, you know! This will be perfect long as Mogilin doesn't find out about the cameras. He's such a nuisance. They need to replace him with a nice lady doctor instead.
goal
Sprinkle the totem with the hyena blood and kill 5 horses near it. Take the Blues' Secret Documents to Denis Stepashin at the Parade Grounds if you find them.
startText

We have to think like a shaman! They frequently summon spirits and entrust them with their secrets. Perhaps that is the solution to this riddle.
They just love all kinds of bloody rituals. Maybe if we pour the hyena blood on the totem and make a few sacrifices a spirit will show up. And then they'll lead us to the documents! How about you herd some horses over here and slaughter them near the totem. Keep it up for a while and see if something happens.
checkText
Why are you back already? Don't tell me the Blues have hidden their documents so well that no one can find them.
finishText
Well done soldier! For your exemplary service to the Empire I am already promoting you to the rank of sergeant. At this rate you'll be leading armies in no time!
goal
Alert Becas the Crafty at the Gamekeepers' Camp.
startText

Aha, speak of the devil! I was just looking for you.
As is customary before the War Games, our generals are about to head over to the Gamekeepers' Camp and have a good bash. The perks of being an officer are great, aren't they? And it's always a good idea to enjoy yourself before a battle - you might not come back!
Any little party you might be planning will have to wait though. The game wardens need to get ready for the officers' arrival and you're going to help them. So gear up, head south, and report to Becas the Crafty. He's the head guy over there and he'll tell you exactly what you need to do.
finishText

What do you want here? I've got my hands full as it is. ...The generals are coming? You don't say! A-friggin-mazing!
Open your eyes you dimwit! They're already here, sitting in the hunting lodge in a nasty mood. They're less than pleased with their reception, so we better act fast or it'll be cesspool duty for a month!
goal
Bring the case of beer to Mikhail Shapkin while it's still cold.
startText

Have you heard the story of how one Orc got three generals drunk? Me neither. Too bad, or all my problems would be solved by now.
Let's try this. Take this keg of beer to the generals and make sure to get there while it's still cold! Carry it as quick as you can and give it to my assistant Mikhail Shapkin. I'm pretty sure that once they've had some of this, they'll be distracted for long enough that we can finish the rest of our preparations before they get too angry.
But remember - there are tons of soldier boys hanging around that won't let beer slip past them just like that. Keep your eyes open at all times! I tell you, nothing's sacred these days - not even officers' booze!
checkText
What was all that yelling about? Did those alchies give you some trouble?
finishText
I thought we were done for! A general without beer is worse than an entire enemy division. But I'm afraid that this isn't the end of our troubles.
goal
Lure 3 Spiny Boars to the markers and wait for the generals to shoot them. Report to Mikhail Shapkin at the Gamekeepers' Camp afterwards.
startText

Our generals have decided to hunt the local boars. Now, they probably haven't held a bow in their hands for years, but they still think this will be a walk in the park. That means we need to give them a leg up or us gamekeepers will be in serious trouble!
There are three zones nearby that are marked as shooting areas. Your job is to lure the boars into the area and hold them there until the generals shoot a few of them. I'm certainly not taking that job anymore - three arrows wounds is enough for me!
Don't give me that look. You're young - wounds heal. Besides, that's the fate of a rookie, taking the jobs others don't want. Hah!
checkText
Ah, if only we knew about the generals' visit earlier. We could have herded some rhinos here. Even they couldn't miss targets that big!
finishText

Phew, we're saved! I heard the generals arguing amongst themselves about whose kills were the most impressive. Hah! I think they should stick to coming up with battle tactics.
Anyway, thanks for your help! Here's a reward for your trouble.
goal
Bring 4 Boar Flanks to Owlka the Wily at the Gamekeepers' Camp.
startText

How are your hunting skills? I guess we'll see soon enough.
There's no time to waste. The army is running low on provisions - again! Go to the prairie and bring me 4 pieces of boar meat. So that's your quota for the day, as per latest orders.
What orders, you say? Are you serious? Reinforcements are dispatched to the Holy Land! We're going to kick the League out of the Pyramid!
Now why are you still here?
checkText

You've heard the new order that was issued by the government, right? Each citizen of the Empire must show their patriotism at all times! So where's your patriotic spirit and where's that meat for our heroic soldiers?
finishText
Alright, the provisions are here! Good job. Although there can never be enough meat. It's just a matter of time before I get another order from headquarters requesting more provisions.
goal
Take the Crate of Defective Weapons to Yasskul Addaya.
startText

I have a new order for you. I'm not even sure how it should be tackled myself, or what the exact problem is really...
To cut a long story, our weaponsmith has been doing sloppy work lately. I have personally checked the weapons from the last shipment - the steel is brittle, the handles have been left unfinished, the blades are dull. This smells of neglected duties, if not outright sabotage!
Head to the Igsh Armory and speak to Yasskul Addaya, the master weaponsmith. Bring this crate of defective weapons with you and show them to him. Let's see what he has to say.
checkText
Yes, what is it? I'm extremely busy supplying our troops with the finest weapons you know.
finishText

What kind of an accusation is that! I've been given an award for excellent service to the Empire multiple times! Let me see those things myself.
These are obviously some kind of pathetic imitations. Someone must have switched the cargo on its way to the barracks. I wonder where my weapons are now. You need to find them right away before I'm court-martialed for this nonsense.
goal
Magnetize 4 Iron Markers and bring them to Yasskul Addaya.
startText

Here's what we'll do about this little problem.
Soon I'm going to send out a new shipment and this time I'll mark the boxes with magical markers. This way we can track them down and catch whoever is swapping the cargo.
But first I need to get some magnetized iron. There are outcrops of magnetic rocks all over the place around here.
I'll give you 4 iron markers, and you make sure they're well-magnetized!
checkText

This business with the switched weapons might cost me my job, if not my head!
Magnetize those markers and we'll be sure to catch the bastards!
finishText

Thanks! With these markers I can track my boxes and find out where the weapons are going. I have a feeling there's treason involved. I should probably contact the City Council before the Council decides to contact me.
goal
Discover the reason behind Yasskul Addaya's secret outings.
startText

I've noticed that the master weaponsmith has been acting very suspiciously lately. In particular, Yasskul Addaya seems very fond of walking in the prairies alone. I drew up a map of his standard routes and noted that each time he visits a certain area. I need to see what he's got hidden in there.
Once we uncover his secret we'll be able to bring him to justice. Maybe he's part of a widespread conspiracy! And once we uncover it, I'll get a medal and a leave of absence. Then I'll have all the beauties and cocktails I could want!
finishText
There appears to be an old sarcophagus hidden in the cave. Time has worn it down, but it has clearly been taken good care of.
goal
Speak with Yasskul Addaya about the sarcophagus.
startText

Inside the sarcophagus you can see a very old mummy lying inside.
You should talk to Yasskul Addaya and find out the meaning of all of this.
finishText

Damnit! I was hoping no one was going to find out.
I suppose I'll have to confess. That sarcophagus holds the body of my beloved Taheera. Her spark did not return to her body and she never rose from the dead, but I am still clinging to the hope that it will happen one day. I know that I've broken the law - all the bodies of those who have failed to return must be turned over to the ZIT. But I cannot entrust my beloved to anyone!
goal
Go to Termitka Prison and warn an agent of the City Council about Ignat Petrovin.
startText

Hmm... so you're saying the City Council has me under surveillance for an entirely different reason? They think I sabotaged the research on Nezeb's Staff? I better tell you everything then, for this is no joking matter.
When Nezeb's Staff was delivered to us, it was just a piece of wood devoid of any magical power. The other experts can corroborate... what do you mean, dead?!
Well then, there can be only one explanation for this! The staff we were given was a fake - a worthless copy! The real staff must have been handed over to the traitors!
I don't know who could have made the switch. I do know the staff was delivered to us by Ignat Petrovin, a Priest of the Trinity Church. I heard he's actually nearby at the moment, inspecting Termitka Prison where League prisoners of war are being held. You should go to the prison as soon as possible and warn an agent of the City Council that there might be treachery afoot.
finishText

I'm sorry, but your information is a little too late. We're already aware that Ignat is a traitor. You see, he arranged for some weapons from the Igsh Armory to be smuggled out and distributed to the prisoners during a routine inspection. They recently made a daring escape, but thankfully they haven't made it too far yet.
goal
Collect 4 Rhinoceros Bones and bring them to Sarang Neferkare.
startText

You can come closer, I won't bite.
Many people fear necromancers and believe them to be servants of death. That is completely untrue - there is more life in our art than you can imagine!
I came here from the Necro-Incubator. Our main job there is to make zombies and skeletons that soldiers can practice their techniques on. However, right now I have a somewhat unusual order.
I've been sent to gather rhinoceros bones. Fighting beasts really isn't my specialty, but if you help me out I'll return the favor. Bring me 4 rhinoceros bones.
I agree, it's a bit of an odd request. Then again, most of the work done at our facility is quite odd.
checkText
Don't ask me what those bones are for! My coworkers are probably getting ready for another experiment.
finishText
Just put them down over there. Those will do quite nicely. And no, I didn't forget about the reward I promised. Here, you can choose from one of these.
goal
Collect 2 Rhinoceros Horns and 2 Unicorn Horns and bring them to Ukhvat the Rowdy.
startText

Hey, would you like to get your hands on a new weapon? No, this isn't a freebie, but if you help me it'll be well worth the effort!
I've decided that I'm going to make my own contribution to the Empire's victory. I've made blueprints for a new kind of weapon! We often do that on Izune.
Now I need materials: horns from local beasts. I'll give you this bone saw. Bring me 2 rhinoceros and 2 unicorn horns.
But be careful - the horns are more brittle than they look and if you're too rough, the horns will break.
If you can handle it, you'll be the first to receive one of my new weapons!
checkText
No, I don't need any broken horns. What would I do with those? Only bring me the whole ones.
finishText

Thank you for your help! This will be a weapon that even an Orc won't be ashamed to hold in his hands!
And as I promised, you get first choice!
goal
Talk to the Nomarkh Khabash at the Necro-Incubator.
startText

You really are in high demand!
The workers at the Necro-Incubator have just requested that we send you over to help with a project. Don't argue with them or they might turn you into some monstrous experiment. Just kidding!
When you get there speak to Nomarkh Khabash. He runs the place and should be able to tell you what's going on.
finishText

While the League is providing tons of support to those Elven demonologists, we here at the Necro-Incubator are forced to fund most of our own research!
To make matters worse, the local cemetery has been depleted and experiments on prisoners of war have recently been forbidden by the Imperial government.
Actually, we were able to make a little deal with the local authorities as to the prisoners, but we'll come back to that later!
At the moment we're hoping your help will make our next project so successful, the authorities will have to be inspired to give us more funding!
goal
Collect 4 Essences of Death and return to Nomarkh Khabash at the Necro-Incubator.
startText

Here's the first mission.
We have studied the texts you found. Among other things, they contain an interesting recipe for creating a zombie animal. We decided to test this technology and ordered some rhino bones from one of our freelance agents. He did a great job.
However, we also need quite a few essences of death for the ritual and we've recently run out of them.
There's an ancient cemetery of my people to the south of here. If you're familiar with the Zem history, you can easily find the essences of death! Weeping Banshees inhabit the cemetery. They will be your target.
checkText
Death is a most interesting process. The study of it opens up truly limitless possibilities.
finishText

Great, this should be more than enough for the ritual.
The rhinoceros bones have already been delivered so we can get started right away.
If the test is successful, the Necro-Incubator will be able to send necro-rhinos to the front in no time.
goal
Kill the Necro-Rhino and return to Nomarkh Khabash.
startText

Aha, we've succeeded!
We created the first necro-rhino Sarnaut has seen in thousands of years! Tep truly was the greatest necromancer that ever lived. But then again, I suppose it is a bit too hasty to say "was". It's quite possible that he's lurking out there even now...
Enough of dark thoughts, let's have a look at our rhino. The experiment isn't over until this creature is tested in battle you know. We must make sure he's tough enough to stand against anything! If you accept this request, I assure that you'll be rewarded handsomely for your help. Soon our funds will start flooding in!
checkText
As I pointed out before, a necro-rhino will be extremely difficult to kill!
finishText

Well, that certainly proved that a necro-rhino is a formidable and nearly invulnerable foe. And this was only a prototype - I'm sure we'll be able to make even stronger ones! We've decided to start serial production of the creature as soon as possible. As promised, here is your hard earned reward!
goal
Kill 4 Defective Zombies and return to Lev Svechin at the Necro-Incubator.
startText

Hang on!
We have a small problem here. You see, one of our experiments didn't go well. The newest zombies weren't up to our standards and now these rejects are shuffling all over our testing grounds.
We'll have to clean the place up, so you need to kill 4 defective zombies. Will you do it for us?
And please don't destroy any good ones while you're at it! We have a shortage of materials and every successful experiment needs to be preserved.
checkText
How are things at the testing range? Is it clear?
finishText
Great, the situation at the range is back under control. I know it was a dangerous job, but somebody had to do it! You sure are one tough soldier!
goal
Deliver the letter to Yasskul Aahotepre.
startText

It's been a while since we had such an able assistant. There's a high turnover rate here for some reason... Oh well. I have one last task for you, but I promise this one will be as simple as they come. Please deliver this letter to the overseer at Termitka Prison. He and I are old friends and I need to remind him to uphold his end of our bargain.
checkText
What have you got there? A letter from the Necro-Incubator? From Khaldun?! Pass it here!
finishText

Alright, let's see what the Nomarkh has to say! ..."Further supplies of inmates are needed at this time"?! What kind of nonsense is that, he's already received his monthly shipment!
Well, I can't help him right now even if i wanted to. Most of the prisoners have escaped. Yes, that's right - some priest brought weapons to the inmates and they broke free! Things have been a horrible mess ever since.
goal
Deliver the Magically Sealed Letter to Negus Tot at Tep's Pyramid.To get a Scroll of Teleportation, complete the quest "The Admiral's Head".
startText

How do you feel about traveling?
The thing is, I need to deliver important documents to the ZIT Headquarters. Important... for me personally, you know. It's not an order, you can say no.
If you agree, then get to the Headquarters and meet with Negus Tot, the director of the illustrious Institute of Magic and Legacy of the Zem People.
Will you do it? This letter is very important to me, and I need you to hand it over in person. As soon as you complete all the combat missions in the IMD, go to the ZIT Headquarters. Agreed?
checkText
Hello there! How can I help you?
finishText
I'm so glad you're here! Ever since we've got the pyramid working, everyone's gone mad searching for the bodies of their loved ones so they can be revived.
goal
Participate in destroying the Defective Savage Zombie and report to Lev Svechin.
startText

One of our most ambitious experiments was to create a zombie that could absolutely destroy the League's forces. We almost succeeded - our creation was dangerous, ferocious, and nearly unstoppable.
There was only one problem - it didn't distinguish between friends and foes! It killed half a dozen workers before it escaped onto the testing range.
It's now a threat to anyone who ventures out there - a threat which must be eliminated. The only option is to kill it, and if you could manage to do this the Necro-Incubator workers would be eternally grateful. One last thing - if you decide to attempt this make sure to bring friends!
checkText
Our hopes were so high when we made that specimen! I guess we focused too much on power and too little on security.
finishText
Good job. We've already started work on another specimen, and this time we'll remember the most important thing - to tell him who's the boss!
goal
Participate in killing Louis de Desirae and report to Colonel Sefu.
startText

In the League, only the Elves learn necromancy. Humans and Gibberlings are too afraid of the power, and Kanians still use their grandmothers' primitive spells. Fools!
I myself have devoted considerable time to studying these arts, both in this and previous lives. If the League didn't have necromancers... We would have conquered the League a long time ago.
It's not easy but it's doable. Now that I have eternity ahead of me, I see things differently... So whenever I encounter Elven necromancers, I kill them as quickly as possible!
At the moment there is an Elven necromancer on the allod, Louis de Desirae. It will not be easy to defeat him.
Perhaps you can gather some friends to help you deal with him. Well? Will you challenge the elf?
checkText
Killing the demonologist will not be easy, but it is must be done before we can take back this allod!
finishText
Good job! A dead necromancer - haha, he must not have been a very good one after all, to succumb to the very element he is supposed to control.
goal
Eliminate League fugitives: 4 soldiers of priests, and Feodor Balandov. Report to Larisa Nevolina.
startText

It's time to bring order to this place. Those fugitives have to be punished for all of the trouble they've caused.
Taking part in this operation would be a good opportunity to boost your reputation in the eyes of all Xadaganians. If you're not afraid of getting your hands dirty, take out a good number of those Elves and Kanians.
And don't forget Feodor Balandov - he yells louder than anyone else about how the League is bound to save them soon. Well, he shall pay for his loose tongue. I must confess, I can't bear to listen to anymore of his nonsense. Sometimes I wish those "bugs" weren't installed after all!
checkText
Ugh, that Balandov has lungs of steel!
finishText
No wonder it's been so quiet lately. It's so refreshing! Thank you for your help.
goal
Search under the coral for any treasure.
startText

There is a large chunk of mysterious coral sitting on the edge of the Dead Sea. Upon further examination, it appears that there are many small scratches on the bottom. Perhaps someone buried a treasure under it long ago.
finishText
Just as you suspected, there is a large chest buried under the coral. Finders keepers!
goal
Find the hidden treasure to the east and report your success to Shildar the Wily.
startText

Rumor has it that an ancient treasure is hidden somewhere to the southeast. It might just be something made up by the Blues to distract us, but I don't think it is.
I know for a fact that a lot of weird stuff happens near the border to the Dead Sea, so I bet the treasure has something to do with that. Maybe some pirate buried it there long ago when the area was still a vast ocean!
I suggest that you search for it while you're off duty. Just make sure it doesn't interfere with your work!
checkText
There's nothing like a good treasure hunt! Even the goodwill of our superiors and following the regulations isn't as important as finding a secret stash of goods!
finishText
Wow, I can't believe you actually found it! No, I didn't doubt its existence, I just doubted your ability to find it! Hah!
goal
Tell the Portal Guardian about your wish to open the portal.
startText

Greetings!
Do you want to open the portal that I'm guarding? Nothing could be simpler!
In the past, portals were protected by powerful Guardians, and one could only open a portal if they satisfied the Guardian's hunger with living creatures. The Historians have discovered ancient writings only a short while ago. The writings belonged not to Junes, but to Elves! The knowledge was recorded at the dawn of this world, and long forgotten even by the Elves themselves. The majority of the manuscripts were valuable only from a historical standpoint. However, several of the scrolls contained writings about the creation of portals and controlling the Guardians. These days the Guardians are back to performing their original duty - protecting the portals from ruin. And without any sacrifices!
If you want to open the portal, all you have to do is ask.
checkText
Well, should I open this portal for you?
finishText

As you wish!
This portal is now open for you!
text
Hello there! How can I help you?
goal
Bring 10 Bronze Strips to Marianna Preminina.
startText

You there! Come here. Sometimes completing what is expected of us is not enough. In these hard times we must go above and beyond!
Right now the Imperial Army has a very tight budget. In order to make sure every soldier is equipped with the newest equipment we are asking for volunteers to donate supplies.
Bronze strips are what we're lacking the most. They're used to make almost everything - cannons, shields, belt buckles. If you bring me a bundle of them, I'll make sure your good deeds are remembered.
checkText
We must supplement our budget with volunteer work! Any loyal citizen of the Empire would be glad to support such a cause!
finishText
Thank you for these supplies! A well-geared Imperial Army will make sure to send those League soldiers running.
goal
Find Strina the Fierce in the Meteorite Mine in the Dead Sea.
startText

I have some good news to follow on the heels of this tragedy. As soon as Sino informed me of Voxar's existence, I searched for some of his family members. Apparently he had a sister by the name of Strina. Now you need to go in search of not an heir, but an heiress!
According my sources, she is working in the Meteorite Mine on the bottom of the Dead Sea. Do you understand what a dangerous job that is? There could be cave-ins, floods - anything can happen to a miner! You must hurry and find her as quickly as you can.
The mines are located far to the east of here, in the southern part of the Dead Say. It's not hard to find, but I'm sure you could ask someone for directions if you need to. Like the shamans say, the tongue can even lead one to Kania. Now hurry, and may the power and wisdom of the shamans go with you!
finishText
...Those skeletons? They don't attack me because... it was me who summoned them. I didn't mean any harm, I swear! I don't even know how I did it. Please believe me!
goal
Obtain 4 samples of Sulfuric Dust in Geyser Pools for Mikhail Korleone.
startText

A basic analysis has revealed many interesting things. This cube is made of well refined, purified sea salt. It's much, much stronger than anything we have dealt with in the past. But there are also some traces of magic in it, and some sort of sulfur dust.
The first thing we should identify is this dust. Sulfur can be found in abundance right here on the bottom of the Dead Sea. It's all over the place at the Geyser Pools. But the thing is, most of the geysers emit different types of sulfuric compounds.
Could you go there and bring me back a few samples? Than I can have them compared and we can identify this new ingredient.
checkText
If we find a direct match with the samples down at the Geyser Pools, we can begin to figure out how these things are made.
finishText
Excellent! I will have my workers analyze this immediately.
goal
Kill 4 drug mafia militants in Geyser Pools and report to Boros the Brazen in Pridonsk.
startText

Yes! Exactly what you heard! In Pridonsk sea salt is prohibited, and people like you deserve to die. Ah, so you're not a salt trafficker anymore? Then who sent you here, the goblins?
You have it all messed up, all of you Imperial scum. Have you ever seen a goblin - just one! - in Pridonsk? Even half a goblin? Clean out your eyes! There are no goblins among us, they're all pathetic salt lickers and they are strictly prohibited from coming in here. We are free people. Free from this foolishness too!
The new sea salt cubes? Yeah, I've heard about them. We were the first people to suffer from its producers. Why? Because they kidnap the Freeborn and then feed them the sea salt to test its effects. What does it do, you ask? Well how should I know, besides the obvious fact that it drives them mad!
Those mongrels make their camps near the Geyser Pools to the north. If you want to prove to us that you're not lying, go spread their brains over the entire desert!
checkText
Yesterday two more kobolds went missing! Those bastards must not kidnap any more of my people!
finishText
Is it finished then? Alright, I'll trust you. I apologize about the sand worm story, but I wouldn't have lied if you hadn't!
goal
Liberate 4 Freeborn and report to Vete the Leafsinger.
startText

Are you heading to the Geyser Pools? Oh, it's so scary there! It's a real nightmare - fire, sulfur, monsters! All we Freeborn want is a peaceful life free of strict rules. Yet the members of the mafia kidnap us and torture us with that horrible sea salt! We don't deserve such treatment!
Please help them escape from that place. I fear that time is running out for them, for they are wasting away under the effects of that salt. If you're truly our friend, then you won't abandon us...
I don't have much to offer as a reward, but I can give you this ring if you'd like. The lives of my friends are worth more to me than shiny baubles!
checkText
They are being held there in cages. What horror...
finishText
Our friends have all come back home! Thank you so much! It's been a while since we've had such a joyful day - it's like a fresh woodland breeze blew through our hearts!
goal
Obtain 2 Firestones and 2 Vials of Manticore Blood in Geyser Pools for Oledor the Cunning in Pridonsk.
startText

I can make the best moonshine you've ever had! It can even get Boros drunk! Don't believe me? Ask him yourself! Actually, no, that's probably not a good idea. He might knock you out for asking that question. Something about maintaining his image.
What? You want to try some of it? Sure, I've got a whole jug right here! ...Oops, it seems like I ran out. Damn, I don't even have any ingredients left to make more. The first customer of the morning and I'm already out of supplies, how embarrassing!
Hey people, listen up! The best moonshine ever will be given to the one who brings me enough firestones and manticore blood. And I'll give it to you for free! Do you hear that?
What do you mean, where do you find the stones? You need to destroy the fire elementals near the geyser pools. And the manticore blood you can get from the manticores, of course.
People? Where are you all going? Don't leave! Oh, this is so typical.
checkText
The moonshine will be ready soon, very soon - as soon as someone will brings me those ingredients!
finishText
Wow, what brave a guy! Hey people! Listen up! A new batch of moonshine is on the way!
goal
Report Boros the Brazen's offer to Alexey Sinitsyn.
startText

I thought about things for a bit. Well, if this is how it is and the people of the small dome want to eradicate all the sea salt, then that's a good thing. And Pridonsk won't be able to do it all by itself.
Tell that guy from the Council that we want to cooperate with him, but only until we conquer that demonic salt. And after that we go our separate ways, tell him exactly that.
The Freeborn never have and never will kiss anybody's feet! We make our own rules and live life how we choose!
finishText

What do you mean there are no goblins in Pridonsk? Yeah, you're right, stereotypes are a terrible thing. I should have visited that place myself. It's my failure, I admit it.
Well, I am happy to accept Boros' offer. This is a decisive moment in our plans and we need all the help we can get.
goal
Try the Sea Salt Cube and report your experience to Mikhail Korleone.
startText

Alright, so we have identified the type of sulfur that is used in the sea salt cube, but we still don't know exactly what it does to the user. Judging by what happened at the mine, it appears to induce some pretty strong psychological effects.
I am afraid that something very dangerous was developed by my father. You see, mental abilities run in my family. Even I have some of the gift. I am constantly getting echoes of other peoples' thoughts in my head. It can be hard to deal with, but it can also be very useful.
I'm afraid that there's only one way to find out what this new sea salt does - you'll have to taste it. Don't worry, after you take it I'll help control your consciousness. This will shorten the period of effect and prevent any future addiction.
But I do have to be straight with you, this is still very dangerous. You have a choice, you don't have to do this. But remember, this mission is very important to the Empire.
checkText
Did you try the refined sea salt yet?
finishText

Oooh, I just barely managed to control its effects. What power!
You say you heard the voice of Nezeb? That's impossible, he would never speak to those under the influence of such a vile substance. And we love and respect him! If he ever returned, we would all be on his side. What could be the meaning of those words?
goal
Collect 4 vials of Scorpion Blood, charge the Spirit Staff, and summon the Scorpion King. Defeat it and collect its essence. Then report back to Sarang Eshe at the Seventh Seabed Resort.
startText

I have a very important task for you.
I can't give you all the details, but remember these instructions. Take this Spirit Staff and this sacred vial. Go to the area south of the Geyser Pools. There you will need to kill four scorpions. Make sure to remember this! It's just the beginning. Use the vial to collect their blood. Then you must sprinkle it on the staff to charge it with spiritual energy.
No, no, this has nothing to do with necromancy. It's the pagan magic of the shamans. But slightly modified. Anyway, just do as I say. As soon as the Staff absorbs the blood, it will summon the spirit of an ancient scorpion known as the Scorpion King. Yes, you can guess the next part. You'll need to kill it, too! And that will make you the master of its spirit.
Then come straight back to me, okay? Got it? It's not an easy task, but it's very important. When this is all over, I'll tell you why.
checkText
Have you summoned the Scorpion King yet? Have you managed to kill him?
finishText
This is great! I hope you followed all of the instructions correctly. If not, you could be in for a considerable amount of suffering.
goal
Bring a sample of the strange obelisk to Negus Kheket.
startText

I was walking along the coast to the north of here and I found a very scary place. There was some sort of strange obelisk surrounded by big black shadows. I didn't get to have a good look at it, but I could tell it was full of dark magic. Perhaps that's where they came from, and then they flew to all parts of the desert. I didn't think about it very much, I just ran away as fast as my legs would carry me.
I'm so glad that someone is going to take care of those shadows! Please find that cursed place and get rid of this pestilence. I myself have only recently become a Servant, so I don't think I'll be able to help you.
Maybe you could go up the coast and find some piece of evidence that you could show to someone more knowledgeable? I'm pretty sure some of those Arisen scientists would know what to do. You better head on over to Nezebgrad with whatever you find. The best minds will be there.
checkText
Greetings to you again! What heroics are you up to now?
finishText
Secret rituals, black stones... Yes, it's all very curious. Give that stone to me - our scientists will find out the truth.
goal
Plant 3 Advanced Bugs near the generators at Laguna Boil and report to Feodor Sonkin.
startText

We have just received some important news from the City Council. A detachment of Yasker Hawks has been deployed to the northern shore of the Dead Sea in an area known as the Coral Canyon. Now the epicenter of events has been shifted to there!
With their help, this struggle against the salt will soon be over! Go to the canyon and tell Feodor Sonkin that you were sent by me. He's the leader of the operations there and he will be glad to have more help.
Oh, and one more thing. You'll be passing by Laguna Boil on your way up. I want you to take these bugs and plant them near the dome's generators. They're the Arisens' latest creations - I assure you they're quite advanced! You may have to deal with some guards, but c'est la vie.
checkText
At my service? What for? My boys are already taking care of things!
finishText

Ah, you have a special recommendation from one of the Council members. That's great. We'd be glad to have your help - the end is just around the corner and everything needs to go smoothly from here on out.
goal
Bring 4 Earth Essences to Sarbaz Istnofret.
startText

I know that it's hard to rush back and forth in such heat. If the Empire is to make any progress in settling this area, our workers will need to save their strength for other things. That's why I've been told to set up a portal way out here.
I'm not too happy about having to set this up by myself, though. It's using up all my magical power. That's why I'm asking for help from travelers who plan to use this thing in the future.
Hmm... what can I ask you to do for me? Why don't you procure some earth essences. They make great magical catalysts. Where? Don't you see those earth elementals over there? Honestly, maybe I should just do things myself. At least then they'll get done right.
checkText
I'm almost ready to launch the portal, I just need some earth essences to get things going. I asked someone to get them for me, but I can't remember who it was... Damn! Wait, was it you?
finishText
Ah, there they are We have all worked hard, and now we can enjoy the fruits of our labor!
text
Hello there! How can I help you?
goal
Kill 4 Goblins and Lican the Desert Menace from the Northern Shelf Gang. Then report to Jukat the Nomadic at the Seventh Seabed Resort.
startText

This should make you happy. We received news from Rodion that our announcements around Pridonsk did the job! Some forestfolk guy among the Freeborn gave us some really useful information.
It seems he overheard some goblins chatting about their operation to the south of Sector 05. Not only that, they said they came from the Northern Sandbar and that they have a whole base up there!
These goblins have apparently formed some sort of gang. I find that so funny - a gang of goblins! Hahaha, they're so weak. But in any case, there they are, under the brave leadership of some goblin named Lican the Desert Menace. It's enough to make me split my sides, what kind of a name is that!
In any case, it looks like the Freeborn have nothing to do with the salt trafficking after all. Well, I guess I'll believe them for now, but I'll still keep my eye on them! Anyhow, you know what you need to do. You need to find this gang and eliminate them.
checkText
How is that brave gang of goblins, are they still alive? Hah!
finishText
I didn't doubt that everything would go smoothly! Those goblins are an easy target.
goal
Bring 4 samples of Astral Amber to Yasskul Nebetia.
startText

You will not hear me say the word "salt". I am here on a special mission that has nothing to do with local affairs. You were recommended to me by a trustworthy friend of the Council, and I was told to contact you if I needed some help.
I am busy carrying out some observations here and I can't afford to leave my post. However, I really need some Astral Amber. You can find many lumps of it along the shore - it grows there in abundance.
I expect that you've had enough dealings with the City Council to know that there are some situations when you ask no questions. Just do what you're told and do it well. If the need arises, I shall tell you what the amber is for.
checkText
Astral amber is the products of sand colliding with Astral energy. It's quite fascinating, don't you think?
finishText
Aha, Astral Amber from the bottom of the Dead Sea. I can already feel the power of them through my fingers. Now where's that report...
goal
Bring 2 Spider Mandibles and 2 Goblin Jaws to Yasskul Nebetia.
startText

Keep your guesses to yourself, okay? Just do what needs to be done. On the coast to the north of here there is a colony of spiders. It seems that close proximity to the Astral has turned them into vampires, and they don't drink or eat - they just suck the blood from their victims.
I am also interested in the local goblins. They have lived here for a long time, and it looks like the Astral has at the very least affected their minds. They are permanently frenzied. I need to find out what other mutations they have suffered.
So, for my experiments, I need spider mandibles and goblin jaws. Yes, you will have to cut them out of dead bodies. It's dirty work, but the Council would not have ordered this if it wasn't of the utmost importance!
checkText
What do I need the mandibles and jaws for? You should know by now that I'm not going to answer that question.
finishText
Well, even a quick observation proves to me that these creatures were influenced by the Astral.
goal
Deliver the X-13 report to Elizaveta Rysina.
startText

Ok, I am now going to give you a report on Project X-13. It's finally complete! And no peeking - this report is top secret.
Deliver it directly to Elizaveta Rysina in Nezebgrad. She can be found in the basement of Yasker's Tower. And remember, whether you know it or not you've done an indispensable service to your country today.
checkText
What is this? The Project X-13 report? Oh, it's about time! Why the delay?
finishText

I need to read this immediately. Hey, what are you looking at? This is a state secret! Just sign here saying you will not disclose your actions to anyone. Even if you don't know what they were for, even that little bit of information could ruin us!
Here, take this reward from the City Council. I knew I was right to recommend your services! You always get the job done.
goal
Visit the meeting place between the Northern Sand Bar and Saltern.
startText

This appears to be some sort of agreement was made between Viktor Korleone and Lican the Desert Menace. Let's see...
"Lican promises to cause all damage possible to the small dome, known as the Seventh Seabed Resort, up to penetrating the dome and destroying everything that moves and grows within it.
Payment will be made upon completion of the task in gold and refined sea salt.
Written by the personal secretary to Lican, Squeaky the Smart.
Addendum "Keys to Paradise" shall be provided by the courier from the Godfather.
Agreed meeting place is the area between the Northern Sand Bar and Saltern."
checkText
Guards! Guards! Who are you? What do you want? Where are the goblins?
finishText
Stop! I'm not a warrior, I'm a courier! Don't touch me! I'll talk.
goal
Kill 4 Criminal Overseers or Salt Collectors in Saltern. Report to Feodor Sonkin in the Coral Canyon.
startText

Time to start the operation. Our scouts have reported that Saltern, an area directly to the west of here, is a hotbed of activity for the mafia. That's where the bulk of the "white death" comes from.
They have scores of workers gathering the sea salt, and almost as many overseers making sure they stay in line. It's hard work managing a place like that you know - the workers are always tempted to lick the salt and goof off. I'm planning on carrying out an attack that specifically targets this area.
You can join us if you wish. Of course, my Hawks would be able to do it themselves, but it would be nice to see you in action. Then I will know how much I can rely on you to carry out more dangerous missions. So, would you like to take part in this operation?
checkText
Soon they won't have enough people to mine the salt. That will stall their operations until we're able to completely eradicate them.
finishText
The operation to destroy the mafia workers was successful! All participants in the mission are to be rewarded with personalized weapons.
